note: Laclede County's official assessor parcel layer (Laclede_Assessor_Data/MapServer, Parcel layer 8) is on services5.integritygis.com and returns 'Token Required' for the service, its layers and layer 8 alike. The county viewer (Geocortex site) draws parcels from this token-protected service. No public parcel service or file was found; the other sources are paid vendor downloads (landrecords.us, mappingsolutionsgis.com, countygismaps.com).
